source_caption_text:
Never forget when Offset’s friend offered to hold his phone for 2 hours straight while he was on live because he didn’t have a phone stand 😭😂

Via: @kaicenat 

Who remembers when Offset went live with Kai Cenat, but without a phone stand, he needed someone to hold the camera. His friend stepped up and kept the phone steady while Offset talked with Kai and interacted with the stream. After a while, Offset noticed his friend’s veins popping out and asked if his arm was hurting 😭😂

The moment turned into a funny reminder that sometimes the most important person on a livestream is the one behind the camera. Real friend behavior 📱🤝

A real friend moment 😂😂💯
